// typedecl: script-declared struct types built with reflect.StructOf:
// composite literals, field reads and writes, forward references,
// embedded data fields, and json output shaped by the declared tags.
type Point struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
	Y int64 `json:"y"`
}
p := Point{X: 3, Y: 4};
assert.Equal(tb, 3, p.X);
p.X = 5;
assert.Equal(tb, 5, p.X);

q := &Point{X: 1};
assert.Equal(tb, 1, q.X);

var w Point;
w.Y = 7;
assert.Equal(tb, 7, w.Y);

// A declaration can reference one written after it, as in Go, and an
// embedded script struct promotes its data fields.
type Wrap struct {
	Base
	M int64
}
type Base struct { N int64 }
b := Wrap{Base: Base{N: 3}, M: 4};
assert.Equal(tb, 3, b.N);
assert.Equal(tb, 4, b.M);

// The declared tags shape the encoder's output.
buf := bytes.NewBufferString("");
json.NewEncoder(buf).Encode(Point{X: 1, Y: 2});
assert.Equal(tb, "{\"x\":1,\"y\":2}\n", buf.String());
